purpose: Make simultaneous total-human, operator-subset and draft-team accounting executable without inventing Earth resources or a new scheduling algorithm.
implementation: A small harvest.labour adapter for one supplied plough package at one physical origin. Require explicit human, qualified operator and draft-team hours per hectare, explicit net resource availabilities and task window. Operator time is a subset of total human time; reject operator capacity greater than total human capacity, invalid or missing resource definitions, and no-team shortcuts. Use existing FarmOperation/plan_farm; no default Roman coefficient or availability.
output: Completed plough-package hectares and used/unused supplied resources only. No grain, complete annual crop activity, population support or empirical calendar claim. State the partial task scope explicitly.
controls: Manufactured numerical cases with analytically known results: simultaneous capacities, operator subset binding, draft binding, disjoint human/operator/team periods, missing draft input, shared human draw, invalid subset/units, and wrapped time windows if supported by existing scheduler. No new atlas cell or food-model scenario.
exclusions: No new climate/crop/food/route/placement run, Earth draft allocation, arbitrary operator fraction, rate fit, seed-area repair, new crop mix, warehouse work, reserved evidence pools or atlas/default adoption.
